title: Engineer 2, Software Development & Engineering
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting\-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast. **Job Summary**


Engineer 2, IS Solutions Database Administration responsible for supporting, maintaining, and optimizing enterprise database environments. This role focuses on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MongoDB administration, database performance monitoring, query optimization, data integration, reporting services, and operational support activities. You will administer and monitor database platforms, develop and maintain SSIS and SSRS solutions, troubleshoot performance issues, implement backup and recovery processes, and support application teams with database\-related needs. Working closely with senior engineers and developers, you will help ensure the reliability, security, and performance of critical business systems.**Job Description**

### **Core Responsibilities**

* ### **Administers and maintains Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MongoDB database environments.**
* ### **Monitors database health, performance, availability, and scheduled jobs using established monitoring and alerting tools.**
* ### **Performs database backup, restore, recovery, and validation activities to ensure business continuity.**
* ### **Supports database security administration, including user access, permissions, and audit requirements.**
* ### **Troubleshoots database performance issues and implements query tuning, indexing, and optimization recommendations.**
* ### **Develops, supports, and maintains SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) packages for data integration and movement.**
* ### **Develops and maintains SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) reports and reporting solutions to support business needs.**
* ### **Assists with database replication, synchronization, and high\-availability configurations.**
* ### **Collaborates with application developers to optimize database design, queries, stored procedures, and data access patterns.**
* ### **Participates in database deployments, upgrades, patching activities, and change management processes.**
* ### **Creates and maintains database administration documentation, operational procedures, and support guides.**
* ### **Responds to database incidents and operational issues, ensuring timely resolution and communication.**
* ### **Supports vulnerability remediation and database security best practices in partnership with infrastructure and security teams.**
* ### **Contributes to automation efforts using SQL, PowerShell, or Python to improve operational efficiency.**

### **Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* ### **Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.**
* ### **Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.**
* ### **Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game\-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.**
* ### **Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.**
* ### **Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.**
* ### **Drive results and growth.**
* ### **Respect and promote inclusion \& diversity.**
* ### **Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.**

### **Disclaimer:** **This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.**


Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

  

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non\-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best\-in\-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always\-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality \- to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

 **Education**


Bachelor's Degree


While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience.

**Relevant Work Experience**


2\-5 Years

title: Spec-Prog & Proj Mgmt
description:
### **When you join Verizon**


You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and experienced Senior SAM Flexera Specialist with a strong track record in end\-to\-end Publisher Management. You will be responsible for executing the daily lifecycle management software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive initial publisher onboarding, translate software contracts, continuously manage deployment data to maintain accurate Effective License Positions (ELPs), and identify continuous cost optimization opportunities across the software estate.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Executing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of software publishers within Flexera, from hands\-on initial onboarding through ongoing compliance monitoring.
* Interpreting EULAs, Master Services Agreements (MSAs), and purchase histories to accurately build and maintain license records and product use rights (PUR) in Flexera.
* Producing and updating defensible, audit\-ready ELP reports for managed publishers by reconciling entitlements against actual software installations and usage.
* Actively identifying software optimization opportunities by flagging shelfware, over\-licensed applications, and unmanaged installations to drive continuous cost savings.
* Normalizing raw inventory, application catalog items, and software signatures utilizing Technopedia and Flexera's recognition engines.
* Monitoring Flexera Beacon servers, inventory agent deployments, inventory alerts, and data processing jobs to ensure daily platform health.
* Supporting ecosystem integrations between Flexera and external tools, including ServiceNow CMDB, SaaS APIs, and secondary discovery sources .
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.

### **What we’re looking for...**


You are a highly analytical thinker with a deep, hands\-on understanding of software asset management tools and publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent technical and problem\-solving skills, coupled with a proactive approach to maintaining data accuracy and uncovering cost savings. You thrive in a highly integrated data environment and are passionate about operational excellence.


You'll need to have:

* 5 to 7 years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 3\+ years of dedicated hands\-on experience using Flexera.
* Proven track record in executing end\-to\-end publisher management, successfully onboarding and continuously managing software publishers within Flexera.
* Strong understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Adobe, VMware/Broadcom, Red Hat).
* Solid operational knowledge of ecosystem integrations, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, and discovery agent data flows.
* Advanced data analysis skills utilizing Excel and relational database logic to manage and synthesize complex software entitlement data sets.


Even better if you have one or more of the following:

* Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
* Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification of End\-of\-Life (EOL) or End\-of\-Support (EOS) software.
* Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate repetitive data management tasks.


If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

### **Where you’ll be working**


In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**


40### **Equal Employment Opportunity**


Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.
